description: Money-free world state after PERSON-0 (the town's persons: names, births, deaths, offices, save v16) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts . <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money, history and Building.upkeepUnpaid. PERSON-0 changes the world by design (the state records persons; mortality takes residents where a house cannot grow, spec PS-3), so the F0-C1 world no longer applies. The cache must still match the ledger on every tick. MARKET-1 re-pinned seed1City2400 (the market reaches homes along the road; the new-game case is unchanged).
